description: Implementation of the Product Data Access Object (DAO) for database interactions concerning Product entities in an e-commerce system. Contains methods for retrieving products by URL, locale, categories, tax class, store, ID, code, and with specific filtering criteria.

classes.name: ProductDaoImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the ProductDao interface providing database operations for Product entities using JPA.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its SEO URL for a given store and locale, including fetching related associations.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Returns a list of products available in a specific locale and store, filtered by category IDs.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Fetches distinct products belonging to specified categories, including associated data.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories (overloaded with Language parameter)
methods.description: Fetches products for categories filtered additionally by language, with optional pagination.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore (with criteria)
methods.description: Provides paginated product listing for a store with filtering criteria.

methods.name: getProductsListForLocale
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve product list for a store and category IDs avoiding full fetch, optimized for locale listing.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a single product with its localized description and availability info based on product ID and locale.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a product by its ID, including associated data and relationships.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a product by its SKU code, including descriptive and relational data.
